notes: Status is recomputed by scripts/check_release_readiness.py. Automated gates are re-derived from the repository and are never read from this file.
Evidence expires when a file it declares under 'covers' changes between its recorded commit and HEAD. Evidence with no 'covers' expires on any commit change.

0.1.0a3 was published on 2026-09-06 and verified on PyPI. Its gate evidence is preserved in docs/releases/history/0.1.0a3.md and is deliberately not carried here as satisfied: 0.1.0a4 must re-establish it against its own candidate commit.

RELEASE_PLAN.md states the first 0.1.0a4 gate as one automated gate, "Every 0.1.0a3 gate still satisfied". It is decomposed here into the individual 0.1.0a3 gates, because the checker requires every automated gate to have a real implementation and an aggregate over sibling gates would be circular.

A4-13 re-established the engineering, packaging and supported-platform gates on candidate 7bd2525d4c68be63fd9f347c7dd3c6de1c847f30. A4-14 then validated a compact external consumer in a clean environment. Commit 45d09979c042124932ec67cc45b90bc194e09994 adds only release documentation and re-runs the affected documentation/public-import checks; the evidence records declare the paths whose changes invalidate them.

ADR 0068 inserts 0.1.0a5 between 0.1.0a4 and 0.1.0b1 and fixes what each release owns. Only the current target carries gates in this file; the 0.1.0a5 and 0.1.0b1 gates live in RELEASE_PLAN.md until their target becomes current.

ADR 0071 gives agnara-http a public composition API. A4-14 exercised HTTP and MCP from an external installed application without internal imports or monkey patches. The six adapter names remain unpublished and require Pending Trusted Publisher verification before owner-authorized release.

gates.title: Public documentation reflects the implementation
gates.detail: The 0.1.0a3 approval covered the 0.1.0a3 documentation set. A maintainer must review the documentation again against whatever 0.1.0a4 ships, including any composition API the reference applications require.

gates.title: Security and release checks required by QUALITY_GATES.md
gates.detail: Whether 0.1.0a4 remains inside the experimental-alpha exemption is a maintainer decision. Repository security tests pass, docs/THREAT_MODEL.md covers the a4 surface, private vulnerability reporting is enabled, and a 2026-09-08 pip-audit 2.10.1 run found zero known vulnerabilities across 29 locked runtime dependencies. Cycle 3 enabled GitHub secret scanning, push protection and Dependabot alerts/security updates on 2026-09-08. Required Python/Actions CodeQL analysis is being validated in Issue #326. Non-provider patterns and validity checks remain disabled. These controls and the bounded CLI/reserved-package threat analysis inform but do not accept the owner-only security gate.

evidence.command: uv export --locked --all-packages --no-dev --no-emit-workspace --no-hashes --format requirements.txt; uvx --from pip-audit==2.10.1 pip-audit -r runtime-requirements.txt --format json
evidence.result: 29 locked runtime dependencies audited on 2026-09-08; zero known vulnerabilities; docs/THREAT_MODEL.md and named boundary tests present. This evidence informs but does not satisfy the owner-only gate.
